verdict.rationale: There is no documented reset-from-parent or point-in-time restore command. The docs do show that branches can be created and deleted quickly (6s clones, no storage duplication, agents create and delete their own branches), so throwing a branch away and recloning from the source works as a fresh-state workaround without a dump. Missing for 10: a native branch reset-to-parent operation, restore or rollback of a branch to an earlier point in time or snapshot, preservation of branch identity/URL across a reset, and any hands-on corroboration.
